rungs.title: Depth timing: how long after the arm stops is depth reliable
rungs.note: frames taken while moving are ~10 mm off and no time shift fixes them; after the stop they are right at once; they arrive 150 ms (p90 650 ms) late. Rule: frames stamped >= 0.25 s after the TCP stopped (no fixed sleeps); immediate reads = reads 3 s later within 0.2 mm. Left: a 1-4 mm per-view bias

rungs.title: Depth tilt bias in the seat views
rungs.note: 10-21: same static base1 read by the 6-dof CAD fit from 12 views (top-down z0.52/0.60 x yaw 0/+-60, tilted 20/30 from +-x/-y; 0.9-1.3 mm rms each): xy spread median 2.1 max 5.1 mm, yaw 0.94 deg, z 6.5 mm; tilted views worst (y -439..-449). A rigid 6-dof mount correction does not help (leave-one-out 2.7 -> 2.7 mm): not a hand-eye offset - depth intrinsics or arm kinematics next. Until fixed: compare reads from the same view geometry, top-down certification only; the touch insert absorbs the residual. Top-down base views agree with the arm on tilt (base1 ~0.5 deg toward +x). Survey: ablations/logs/handeye_icp/20261021_200144. CLEARS AT: seated end heights within +-1 mm in every view.
